details:
I asked for better request system, because there are scammers around lately. I need more information to make sure it's good player and not a sus player.

Let's take a look why current system / UI is not so good.
- Website overview -
#1 The last changes from old website UI, the message box is now above. Click on it will give a list, with ignore and approve buttons. This is simple overview, so it's not easy to make decisions.
If i click on name player, we go to player page. I noticed the ignore option is not on the player page. That is very weird, because we have only Approve choice, mute and block. What is this design? Where is ignore button? Here we are forced to use list and not player page. Not good UI design.
#2 So we see Ignore option is missing. There is not much about the player status. That is another problem to decide can i trust this player? We have more scammers lately with sudden requests. I need information from the player:
- registration date (when is player registered?)
- sus level / reputation level (how many players reported this player is sus, in other words, how many players got sudden request from this player?)
- how many friends (it should nice to see how much friends the player has made)
- has player also some my friends in list (due friends / friends+ system), how many then?
- when did player played the game for last time (makes easier to remove very dead friends)
#3 I noticed there are two buttons for ignoring player request, but why two buttons? If they have same function, why do you need two buttons? That is kinda UI over-designing. The request age is visible here - that is good!
#4 The one red button to clean up all messages is kinda harsh. It can remove good and safe requests. If you delete all with one click, you might lose some friends. That is not great idea. We need more purge control on the request list:
- clear old requests (like more than 1 month old)
- clear sus requests (the player has high sus level)
- clear inactive players (most likely more than 6 months never played)
- clear low ranked players (not best option, but they are also new or have less good status)
- clear fresh players (best option, less than one week are mostly scammers)
Also the ranking system must time-based and not amount-based. There is NO way you can make 100 friends in less than one week already as new player (except famous person who want make new account) so it's mostly scam.

- ingame view-
And more important, ingame there is no visual who send you request. (picture #5)
With small indication below the name tag, we can see it at another time, so we have better chance to observe the player and / or talk with the player to know more about the player. That is very normal step to make friends in vrchat.
Because without indication, well... nobody has time to look EVERY time at request list (mine is over 100 requests - this problem goes for sure famous players) so this indication will VERY useful to see it immediately.
Also when the (famous) player is very busy and missed the request indication in normal game UI left-bottom. Do you think he want check through the long list? Not really, he has not all the time for it.
Ingame can't show much information about the player, there is not enough room for it. The website can do it.

To sum up, we need better feedback for request ingame at later time. And we should be able to see more stats about the player itself, with his/her repuation level. The Ranking system is not best answer here, it can easy misused by sending many requests (it's known problem) so we need check other numbers to decide better.

This problem is for long time asked in earlier posts of mine:
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/better-friend-request-system
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/friend-request-information-needed
The website UI is renewed lately, which is nice development, but the Friends request management is still weak with very few stats available about the player. Now it's more needed because VRChat is growing bigger, so there will more scammers coming in game. The problem now they send many requests randomly to everyone (using the website list for sure) and that is why i need more stats from the player. I heard this problem exists for long time, but i just noticed lately it's even more worsen with much more sudden requests.

And of course better and faster reporting options, still in request overview. You can add button below each request block to flag player for 'unwanted request without see him/her'.
If more players click on it, then it will raise sus level on player. That means the player sends way too much sudden requests without see them ingame. (optional the sus level can reset after 1 month if no more reports coming in.)

Anyway, sorry for long text, but i want point out i need better management in VRChat game, and even more on the website management with more stats. This will make decisions more easier and faster, and i can clean up the long list faster. Do you agreed we need better management? Please vote this post.
Thank you very much.
title: Friend Request system rework needed
